definition: the science of circuits and their parts
description: A young woman in a green jumper sits at a small table in a room with wooden cabinets and warm wall lamps. Wearing a small magnifying lens on her head, she solders wires inside the open metal chassis of an old valve amplifier, and a bright spark flashes. She then picks up tweezers, frowns as she checks her work and smiles. A smiling young man in a white T-shirt holds up a glass valve beside her. A reel of solder and a tray of small tools lie on the table.
